thread:
maya: CI turned red on the hosted integration suite — auth + streaming + tool-call tests failing across multiple shards. Can someone take a quick look or trigger reruns? http://ci.local/blue/1234 :wave:
ci-bot: Build 1234 failed — 18 tests failed in hosted-integ (shards 4,7,12). Failures concentrated in auth handshake and tool-call schema validation. Logs: http://ci.local/blue/1234/logs
sam: I pulled shard7 logs — seeing repeated 401s from hosted API gateway, token verify returns 'invalid_issuer'.
leo: also seeing a bunch of stream disconnects right after tool-call handoff, could be header mismatch between streaming proxy and runtime.
alex: tagging @aaron-oncall for permission to rerun shards in parallel — we might need parallel replays to catch flake vs regression.
aaron-oncall: go ahead — I'll start parallel reruns for shards 4/7/12. If it repros consistently we should bisect. Command I'm using:
```
ci-rerun --build 1234 --shards 4,7,12 --parallel
```
maya: thx. alex — can you paste the failing request payload (sanitized) for the schema errors? helps to know if tool-call bodies are malformed.
alex: pasted sanitized snippet below — tool_call.payload missing required field `destination` in a few cases:
```
{"id":"req-9a7","tool_call":{"name":"lookup_user","payload":{"user_id":"u-123"}}}
```
sam: that's interesting — runtime should default destination => "runtime" but looks like our validation schema changed in last deploy. Possible change in model-proxy schema?
leo: confirming: commit d4f2a1 (model-proxy) introduced stricter tool_call schema. Rolling back that change locally drops the failures in a quick run.
maya: ok this points at a recent schema tighten. For immediate mitigation can we add a temporary fallback in runtime to accept missing destination? If not, revert the proxy commit.
aar-oncall: reruns done — shard4 green, shard7 still red, shard12 flaky (1/3 runs failed). I'll keep replays running and capture coro ids.
ci-bot: Rerun summary: shard4: 3/3 green, shard7: 3/3 red, shard12: 2/3 green 1/3 red. Attached logs: http://ci.local/blue/1234/reruns
alex: I'll open a quick PR to either revert schema or add migration logic. pinging @eng-platform for review.
maya: please add an explicit test that covers missing destination on tool-call so we don't regress.
leo: also we need to check auth token issuer mapping — saw one expired key in the hosted key-table that might explain the 401s. Not sure if it's related to schema though.
sam: chasing key rotation with infra team, posting audit id: audit#8472
maya: thanks all. Actions: alex -> PR to revert or add fallback; leo -> confirm key-table TTL and rotate if needed; aaron-oncall -> monitor replays and escalate if more shards flip red.
alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-proxy/pull/432 — adding runtime fallback and a schema migration test. cc @maya
aaron-oncall: if shard7 keeps failing after PR lands, we'll bisect across last 5 deploys. For now I'm escalating to infra on-call. :mag:
sam: noted, I'll follow up on the 401s and post an ETA.
maya: great. keeping this thread for async updates — drop quick notes here as you act. :thumbsup:
